title: Alignment by Socialization: Learning Tradeoffs Under Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.18531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are expected to complete tasks while following rules of conduct, but these objectives can conflict. We study how evolutionary selection shapes an agent's choices between them, and whether experience can make those choices reflect human judgments and withstand subsequent pressures. In our model, copies of an agent face a common uncertain reward state, and only those taking the rewarded action reproduce. We show that long-run growth is maximized when each action is taken as often as the environment rewards it. We compare three policies. A task-only policy thrives in a sandbox rewarding completion alone but fails when conduct matters. A fixed linear policy increasingly favors task completion as its stakes rise, even where humans never reward it. A learned policy instead converges to the tradeoffs rewarded by its environment; when humans supply the rewards, we call this socialization. Accumulated experienc

translated_title: 通过社会化实现智能体对齐：选择压力下的权衡学习
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）智能体被期望在遵循行为准则的同时完成任务，但这些目标之间可能存在冲突。我们研究了进化选择如何塑造智能体在这两者之间的抉择，以及经验能否使这些选择反映人类的判断并承受后续的压力。在我们的模型中，一个智能体的多个副本面对共同的不确定奖励状态，只有采取了获得奖励行为的副本才能繁殖。我们证明，当每个行为被采取的频率与环境对其的奖励频率一致时，长期增长被最大化。我们比较了三种策略：仅任务策略在只奖励任务完成的沙盒环境中表现良好，但在行为规范至关重要时会失败；固定线性策略随着任务利害关系的增加越来越偏向任务完成，即使在人类从不奖励这种偏向的情况下也是如此；而学习型策略则会收敛到其环境所奖励的权衡上；当人类提供这些奖励时，我们将此过程称为社会化。积累的经验……
tldr: 该论文提出“社会化”这一对齐机制：在进化选择压力下，学习型智能体会收敛到环境所奖励的任务完成与行为规范之间的权衡；当由人类提供奖励时，智能体的选择便能反映人类判断并经受住后续的选择压力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "socialization" as an alignment mechanism: under evolutionary selection, a learning agent converges to the environment-rewarded tradeoffs between task completion and conduct rules, and when humans supply the rewards, its choices reflect human judgments and withstand subsequent selection pressures.
